title: Control panels
lede: Current live panels (Aug 2026). Digicon CTC, classic CTC machine, and the Neville Island Layout Editor panel. The device browser below defaults to the Digicon CATS board; switch to the LE schematic for full MQTT/hotspot coverage. Crossover plants (SW-7 / SW-23 / SW-35) now render as proper diamonds on the LE view.
